title: M.Tech Chemical Engineering | KSDS KPGU
content: one of the constituent schools of KPGU, Vadodara. The prime focus of our curriculum is to impart technical knowledge, promote problem-solving abilities and build innovation around new-age technologies. Course contents are periodically updated based on recent trends and developments. Activities such as expert lectures, industrial visits, project and activity-based learning are carried out for technical and soft-skill development.
